correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the published 7x6 restriction matrix from the exact sextic. At ell_0 the rank is exactly 4 and a 4x4 minor equals -23520, so local block reduction is valid. The induced 3x2 kernel-to-cokernel linear map has three quadratic 2x2 minors whose coefficient determinant in the basis (u^2,uv,v^2) is 2655279064360000/2401, hence they span m^2/m^3. The local maximal-minor ideal J is contained in m^2 and satisfies m^2=J+m^3; Nakayama gives J=m^2. Therefore the local algebra has basis 1,u,v and length 3. The verifier replays these exact rational calculations from the packaged source.

value.rationale: The primary paper deliberately presents B_0 to show that the jumping scheme can fail to be reduced, but leaves the severity of the nonreduced point unspecified. The exact local algebra is a natural scheme-theoretic invariant of that named example and distinguishes a minimally thick rank-4 determinantal collision from higher multiplicity behavior. It quantifies exactly three units of the global length 171 at ell_0 and provides a concrete local model for studying how jumping lines collide under deformation.
